name: German Physician Number LANR KBV Checksum
description: Validates German Lebenslange Arztnummer (LANR) per KBV Arztnummern-Richtlinie §75 SGB V. Weights [4,9,4,9,4,9] are applied to the first 6 digits. The check digit at position 7 equals (10 - (sum mod 10)) mod 10. Digits at positions 8-9 are the specialty code and are not part of the checksum.
